{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
git -C .\workspace log --oneline -15
Write-Output '--- STATUS ---'
git -C .\workspace status --short --branch
Write-Output '--- HEAD ---'
git -C .\workspace rev-parse HEAD"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Write-Output '--- all .jsx files ---'
Get-ChildItem .\workspace -Recurse -Filter *.jsx -File | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Replace((Get-Location).Path + '\workspace\','') }
Write-Output '--- App.jsx imports (first 30 lines) ---'
Get-Content .\workspace\web\src\App.jsx -TotalCount 30
Write-Output '--- components .js sample (ActivityPanel.js head) ---'
Get-Content .\workspace\web\src\components\ActivityPanel.js -TotalCount 3"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Write-Output '--- references to components .jsx across repo ---'
Get-ChildItem .\workspace -Recurse -Include *.js,*.jsx,*.cjs,*.mjs,*.html,*.json,*.md -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch 'design-references|node_modules|\.git' } | Select-String -Pattern "components/[A-Za-z]+\.jsx|\.jsx'" -List | ForEach-Object { $_.Path.Replace((Get-Location).Path + '\workspace\','') + ':' + $_.LineNumber + ': ' + $_.Line.Trim() }
Write-Output '--- legacy entry files exist? ---'
Test-Path .\workspace\web\index.html
Test-Path .\workspace\scripts\run-web-workbench.js
Test-Path .\workspace\src\web\createWebWorkbench.js
Test-Path .\workspace\src\core\handoff\createMarginSurface.js
Test-Path .\workspace\bin\margin.js
Test-Path .\workspace\.runtime
Test-Path .\workspace\node_modules"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Write-Output '--- src/core top-level files ---'
Get-ChildItem .\workspace\src\core -File | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }
Write-Output '--- createMarginSurface.js head ---'
Get-Content .\workspace\src\core\handoff\createMarginSurface.js -TotalCount 40
Write-Output '--- MARGIN_CORE_MIGRATIONS refs ---'
Get-ChildItem .\workspace\src -Recurse -File | Select-String -Pattern 'MARGIN_CORE_MIGRATIONS' -List | ForEach-Object { $_.Path.Replace((Get-Location).Path + '\workspace\','') }
Write-Output '--- test file count ---'
(Get-ChildItem .\workspace\test -Filter *.test.js -File).Count
Write-Output '--- session start epoch / commit epochs ---'
[DateTimeOffset]::FromUnixTimeSeconds(1788689897).ToString('u')
[DateTimeOffset]::FromUnixTimeSeconds(1788716676).ToString('u')"}

{"command":"[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
Write-Output '--- any file mentioning DELETE CANDIDATE / cleanup audit ---'
Get-ChildItem .\workspace -Recurse -Include *.md,*.txt,*.json -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\.git|node_modules|design-references' } | Select-String -Pattern 'DELETE CANDIDATE|cleanup audit|11 个|薄包装' -List | ForEach-Object { $_.Path.Replace((Get-Location).Path + '\workspace\','') }
Write-Output '--- input dir ---'
Get-ChildItem .\input | Select-Object Name, Length
Write-Output '--- _tmp dir ---'
Get-ChildItem .\_tmp -Recurse -Depth 3 | Select-Object FullName | Format-Table -AutoSize"}
